title: How to close a feature without losing unsaved work
problem: The host owns the frame and can tear it out whenever it likes, but only the embedded feature knows whether a draft, an armed timer, or an unsent edit is still inside, and removing an iframe fires nothing the feature can act on.
outcome: A feature that declares unsaved work as it changes, a host that takes that declaration into account before starting a teardown, a last flush window on a channel that still delivers, and a close control inside the feature that asks the host rather than acting alone.

knowledge: Access to both sides, or agreement with the team that owns the other one, since the exchange needs a contract action and a handler at each end
